## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d62511d7bbeda49a71979ede5220120981f2598b`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #11681 (body, every comment: the ruling `6017839148`, the revised claim `6176207338`, the three dev reports), PR #12387 (body, 12-file list, net diff against `main` `0a63422ec`), and the 33 check-runs on the head: 30 `success`, 3 `skipped` (dependabot, the two coverage shards), none failed. A fetch of `pull/12387/head` into the read-only checkout was the only local act; nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Each accept-set or public-surface movement the diff implies, named right or wrong:

1. **`@object-ui/core` — `ChartResultField.aggregate?: string`, `ChartSeriesBinding.aggregate?: string`** (`packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts`). Right. Optional, typed `string` for the same reason `BuiltinAggregateCarrier` gives (untrusted wire value, judged at the read); `DatasetResultField` extends `ChartResultField`, so `measureField(m)?.aggregate` in the widget reads the spec's own `fields[].aggregate` (`@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.0, the producer half the ruling waited for, confirmed met in `6159861162`). Type Check green on the head.
2. **`@object-ui/core` — new exports `INTEGER_AGGREGATES` (`count`, `count_distinct`) and `isIntegerAggregate(unknown): boolean`**, reached through `export * from './utils/chart-series.js'` on the package entry. Right, and exactly the ruling's Q3 A: `sum`/`min`/`max` over a `scale: 0` field are not judged integer. `isIntegerAggregate` answers `false` on absence and on any non-string, so the axis can only ever gain `allowDecimals: false`, never lose a decimal it had.
3. **`buildChartSeries` spreads `aggregate` onto every series it derives** (the pivoted groups all carry the one measure's aggregate; the plain path copies per value column; absent unless the column states a string). Right. `ObjectChart.tsx` and plugin-report's `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` already pass `state.fields`, so they pick it up with no edit, as the PR says.
4. **`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` — `DatasetWidget`** builds `measureAxisSeries` for the dimensionless (transposed) chart with an aggregate only when the `Set` of plotted measures' aggregates has size 1 and is a string; the comparison overlay copies its primary's member; the non-transposed compared series read `measureField(m)?.aggregate`. Right. A mix states none, so the conservative direction holds (non-integer is never asserted); the overlay never costs its axis the whole ticks. No export of the package moves, so `patch` is right here.
5. **`@object-ui/plugin-charts` — `ChartRendererProps.schema.series`, `dataKey` arm, gains `aggregate?: string`**; `normalizeSeries` reads it through `str()` (empty string dropped); `NormalizedSeries.aggregate?: string`; new module-level `plotsWholeNumbers(series)`, true exactly when at least one series is bound and every one passes `isIntegerAggregate`; `yAxisSpecProps` spreads `{ allowDecimals: false }` only in that case, ahead of `numericAxisSpecProps`, which never emits `allowDecimals` (0 hits in the tree outside this spread), so nothing overrides it. Right on the renderer side: every cartesian value axis takes its props from `yAxisSpecProps` (the vertical left/right `YAxis` elements at `:2761`/`:2762`, the combo axes at `:2912`/`:2921`/`:2931`, the horizontal-bar number `XAxis` elements at `:2870`/`:2871`/`:2880`, scatter's `YAxis` at `:2667`), with `slotSeries(side)` deciding per dual-axis slot, so a sum beside a count on one slot keeps the default. The ruling's Q2 a is carried exactly: renderer-internal member on the internal arm, derived per slot. `plotsWholeNumbers` is NOT re-exported from `src/index.tsx`, but `NormalizedChartSchema` (re-exported by name) and `ChartRenderer`'s props type both widen by the optional member. See ② for the level this implies.
6. **`@object-ui/types` — `ChartDataSeriesSchema.aggregate = retirementTombstone(...)` and `ChartDataSeries.aggregate?: never`**. Right, and it is the by-name refusal the ruling required (`⛔ No authored key`, the objectui#7744/#7694 `chartType` precedent). FROM: the non-strict object stripped `{ name, aggregate: 'count' }` in silence while the raw node reached the renderer. TO: one `invalid_type` issue at `aggregate` (`series.0.aggregate` on the node) carrying the objectui#11681 guidance; the TS twin is a `tsc` error at the authoring site. The parse flip is measured by ablation (4 red with the member renamed away). Narrowing, and intended: an author could otherwise strip a currency sum's decimals.
7. **Not touched, judged right:** `ChartImpl.tsx` (the inline bar gets `data` + `dataKey` and no measure fact; the card's `:105` pointer was the triage seat's guess, and no measured chart renders through it); radar's `PolarRadiusAxis` (recharts 3.10.1 already defaults `allowDecimals` false).
8. **Pins against the card's Done-when.** `ChartRenderer.integerMeasureTicks-11681.test.tsx` (10 real-DOM tick cases: bar/line/area/count_distinct/horizontal-bar/dual axis, plus controls: currency sum on bar and horizontal-bar keeps decimals, no aggregate keeps the measured fractional ticks, sum beside count keeps default) and `DatasetWidget.integerMeasureTicks-11681.test.tsx` (9 full-chain cases with the measured `{ name: 'task_count', label: 'Tasks', aggregate: 'count' }` shape, the dimensionless chart, the overlay, and a `currency: 'USD'` sum control). Both halves of the card's pin are present; the ablation (12 red / 7 green of 19, restored clean) shows the spread is load-bearing. Test shards 1–12, `Test (dist pins)`, `Build & E2E` all green on the head.

No derived judgment in the diff is wrong. The only finding is the level in ②.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/11681-integer-measure-ticks.md`: `plugin-charts: patch`, `plugin-dashboard: patch`, `core: minor`, `types: minor`; body carries `Clause-②: yes (an export widens, and an accept set narrows)` with the FROM → TO migration for the `types` narrowing. PR body line: `Clause-②: yes`, no arm.

- `Clause-②: yes` — right: a mixed movement (core widens, types narrows), and the closed pair allows at most one arm, so declaring none and naming both movements in words is the correct spelling. `skip-changeset` is correctly absent.
- `core: minor` — right (two new exports plus two optional interface members; "yes takes at least minor").
- `types: minor` — right by this repo's own rule. The narrowing is named in release-reader words (FROM/TO, the one-line fix "delete the key; declare the aggregate on the dataset measure"), which is what the `chartType` refusal `caf477f` (objectui#7694 on #7546) and #7113 shipped as `minor` in the same `CHANGELOG.md`; `major` would be refused by `Changeset Bump Policy` (`check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: objectui's major is pinned to `@objectstack`'s). objectui carries no ADR-0087 registration gate, so the objectstack-side marker rule does not read this changeset.
- `plugin-dashboard: patch` — right; no exported surface of that package moves.
- **`plugin-charts: patch` — WRONG; it must be `minor`.** The diff adds `aggregate?: string` to the `dataKey` arm of `ChartRendererProps.schema.series` (the props type of the exported `ChartRenderer`) and to `NormalizedSeries`, which `NormalizedChartSchema` — re-exported by name from `src/index.tsx` — carries. That is the same movement as `aa6be30` (objectui#8086, `type?: string` on the same arm), which this package's `CHANGELOG.md` 17.7.0 lists under **Minor Changes** with the words "The accept set only widens … nothing that compiled before is refused." The PR body's "Two contract movements" undercounts: there are three, and the third is the one the changeset grades `patch`. `Changeset Bump Policy` cannot see this (it only refuses `major`), and `Changeset Declaration` checks presence, so the gates being green does not settle it.

**Fix (one edit, no code change):** in `.changeset/11681-integer-measure-ticks.md` set `"@object-ui/plugin-charts": minor`, and in the changeset body's `plugin-charts` bullet and the PR body's Clause-② section name the third movement: the `dataKey` arm of `ChartRendererProps.schema.series` and `NormalizedSeries` / `NormalizedChartSchema` gain an optional `aggregate` (accept set widens; nothing that compiled before is refused). Then re-request this record on the new head.

### ③ Boundary flags

Every dev flag and `open_questions` entry on the card, answered or escalated:

- Report `6016728499` Q1/Q2/Q3 (where the integer fact comes from, how it reaches the axis, scope) — **answered** by triage `6017839148`: Q1 A1, Q2 a, Q3 A. The diff follows all three (see ① 1, 5, 6, 2).
- Report `6176279787` open question (widen the file surface to the ruled route: options A/B/C) — **answered**: the claim `6176207338` was revised in place to option A (core, plugin-dashboard, plugin-charts, types, and the tests of each); the diff's 12 files sit inside that surface. The `Clause-②: to be measured` line in the claim was closed by the dev's measurement (`yes`), and the PR carries `needs:contract-review`, which is this record.
- Report `6177471473` deviations: (a) `origin/main` merged into the branch at `d62511d7b` rather than rebased — **accepted**; the net diff against `0a63422ec` is exactly the 12 files, and every gate ran on the merged head. (b) `ChartImpl.tsx` in the widened surface but unchanged — **accepted**, ① 7. (c) PR footer in the role file's session-URL form, model-free trailers — **accepted**; no model identifier in the PR or the changeset. (d) `check:spec-floors` exit 1 locally, the known main-side objectui#12334 — **not a flag on this head**: `Repo Gates` is green on `d62511d7b`.
- The ruling's "stale line address in `normalizeSeries`' docblock is repaired in the same PR" — **done**: `ChartRenderer.tsx:65` replaced by the arm's name; `Line Citation Gate` green.
- Governed surface: the file list touches no register row (no `.claude/**`, no `docs/adr/**`); `Governed Surface Queue Guard` green. The head repo is `objectstack-ai/objectui`, not a fork.
- Nothing is escalated. The one open item is the ② level, which the dev can close without a ruling.
